changelog: DVR OTG FIX: Firestick USB recording now works WITHOUT the broken FireOS SAF file picker — the app directly detects your OTG drive via getExternalFilesDirs() (no permission dialogs, no keyboard required)
DVR: Recording engine switched from LibVLC :sout to FFmpegKit -c copy — lower CPU on Firestick, better stream compatibility, no re-encoding
DVR: New 3-tier storage picker — tap your USB drive directly from a list (OTG shown first, then internal, then custom folder)
DVR: FireOS USB Setup Guide built into the app — step-by-step wizard for FAT32 formatting, powered OTG hub setup, and Bluetooth keyboard instructions
DVR: Storage path priority chain: OTG USB → Primary external → SAF custom folder → Internal (last resort)
DVR: Storage space check before recording starts — warns if less than 500MB free
DVR: File size live polling now works on all paths including OTG
Manifest: Added USB Host feature declaration, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, and USE_EXACT_ALARM permissions
FileProvider: DVR recording paths (internal and external) now properly exposed for file sharing
